output.summary: An evergreen succulent native to Madagascar, flaming Katy grows naturally in humus soil on the relatively cool Tsarantanana plateaus. It has glossy, scallop-edged leaves and produces red, pink, orange, gold or white flowers from late autumn into early winter; parts are poisonous if swallowed.
output.edibilityNote: Unspecified parts are poisonous if ingested.
